description: Shared vectors for the price grid: TypeScript grid.ts and Rust engine.rs must both reproduce them. Prices are integer strings in 1e-8 USD; times are integer seconds since the Match started; picks are rows per seat (255 = no pick); lo/hi null = column without data (cannot be hit). Expected values come from an independent naive reference (python), not from either implementation.

vectors.name: flat-line
vectors.note: flat price: only row 4 is hit

vectors.name: exact-edges
vectors.note: price on row edges: lower bound inclusive, upper exclusive

vectors.name: far-outside
vectors.note: huge and tiny prices clamp to the open-ended rows

vectors.name: empty-columns
vectors.note: carry-over: columns without samples take the last price before their window

vectors.name: only-end
vectors.note: no samples: columns before the end have no data; column 11 sees only the end price

vectors.name: late-start
vectors.note: no line before the first sample: earlier columns cannot be hit

vectors.name: carry-over
vectors.note: the price that entered column 1 at t=40 counts for it (it was recorded at t=39)

vectors.name: last-seconds
vectors.note: a sample at t=149 and the end price both land in column 11

vectors.name: random-0
vectors.note: seeded random walk, 80% of seconds sampled
